g.text: Major responsibilities inside the Node.js orchestrator process.

g.data-qualified-name: JobOps.n.size.16..Software System...size..Orchestrator API.n.size.16..Container. Node.js. Express. TypeScript...size.

g.text: Uses authenticated request context and authorization
Starts and controls pipeline and job processing
Imports, edits, generates, uploads, and downloads resume artifacts
Reads and updates application lifecycle data
Configures providers and reviews email matches
Reads and writes settings and domain data
Scores jobs and generates tailored content
Persists runs, jobs, progress, and artifacts
Loads scoped settings, profiles, jobs, notes, and documents
Optionally imports resumes and exports PDFs
Loads resume sources and stores artifact metadata
Persists stages, tasks, notes, interviews, and outcomes
Classifies relevance and matches messages to jobs
Applies approved or high-confidence stage changes
Stores integrations, messages, and sync runs
Reads and writes scoped relational data
Reads and writes PDFs, resume assets, documents, backups, and extractor state
Loads queued work and persists results
